issues.issue: Was the officer's credibility finding reasonable, given that it relied on an implausibility analysis?
issues.applicant_position: Implausibility findings are permissible only in clearest cases; country evidence shows roundups infrequent, so the finding was impermissible.
issues.respondent_position: Implausibility analysis was reasonable and rational; inconsistencies in testimony also support the credibility finding.
issues.result_quote: I find that the implausibility analysis is a reviewable error that undermines the reasonableness of the Decision.

issues.issue: Did the officer fail to assess all grounds of persecution?
issues.applicant_position: Officer failed to assess all grounds of persecution.
issues.result_quote: it is unnecessary for the Court to consider the other issues raised by the Applicant in this application.

issues.issue: Was the failure to contemporaneously prepare interview notes a breach of procedural fairness?
issues.applicant_position: Failure to prepare notes during the interview breached procedural fairness.
issues.result_quote: it is unnecessary for the Court to consider the other issues raised by the Applicant in this application.
